visualCharacteristics.structure: h1 eyebrow + heading + text + action link + callout card(text + button + link)

contentPattern: 1 row, 2 cells. Cell 1: H1 'Welcome to VA.gov', H2 'Let us help you get started', paragraph, link 'Get started with VA'. Cell 2 (callout card): paragraph/H2 'Create an account…', link 'Create account' (bold = primary button; href e.g. /sign-in or #sign-in since source is a modal button), link 'Learn how an account helps you'. No background image row — gradient is CSS.
